plugins.description: Makes GSD compare mechanisms before execution and keeps numerical precision and measured performance visible through shipping: four advisory prompts, plus a blocking plan:post gate that requires a compliant Alternatives Considered section on every plan in a phase.

plugins.name: pr-workflow
plugins.description: Wraps gh CLI to read PR/check status for the current branch; execute:wave:post writes a gate-readable PR.md report, ship:pre gates advisorily on it.
